title: Chicken tinga tacos
ingredients: 2 chipotles in adobo, plus 1 tbsp of the sauce
steps: Simmer the chicken with the salt and bay leaves in just enough water to cover, about 20 minutes. Shred it and keep 1 cup of the broth.
Blend the tomatoes, onion, chipotles and adobo sauce until smooth.
Fry the sauce in a wide pan for 8 minutes until it darkens, then add the chicken and enough broth to loosen it. Cook 10 more minutes.
Warm the tortillas, fill, and finish with coriander and a squeeze of lime.
notes: Use one chipotle for mild, three for properly spicy. The filling keeps for three days and gets better overnight.
